big_case.notes: Independent legal review of NLRB statutory interpretations has national relevance, but this petition arises from an unpublished, evidence-dependent classification ruling about producers at one station. The petition itself identifies subsequent circuit authority accepting independent legal review; the denial establishes no new Supreme Court rule.

leakage.notes: Forward run on October 30, before the November 16 resolution. All 46 calls are outcome_only (captured coverage 0.0): their null digests/dates do not establish empty results. The own-docket query and Nexstar search are assessed from their queries and the prose; the latter is restricted to the Second Circuit. The described Siren Retail and Menonita material predates resolution. No evidence shows this petition already decided when predicted.
